items: New sounds, all made in the music's key: a creature turning angry growls, one turning happy pops, and an invite ends in a flourish, fuller for bigger animals
Sleeping legends snore softly and dream in a quiet tone; a restless one's sleep turns uneasy; a legend winding up an attack sounds it a second before
Areas that have joined the party add their own beat to the music as you fly near
💌s get their sounds (a soft fire, a chime on a hit, a tick as the heart fills) as soon as they land
